scripts.name: 同工序版本一道工序报工多次的工票
scripts.content:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT 
    process_version_id as 工序版本id,
    crop_order_ticket_id as 工票id,
    process_serial_no as 工序号,
    produce_process_name as 工序名称,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY process_version_id,crop_order_ticket_id, process_serial_no 
      ORDER BY id ASC
    ) AS  报工次数
  FROM jack_mes.produce_produce_reporting_work
  WHERE 
    is_deleted = 0 and crop_order_ticket_id IS NOT NULL
) t
WHERE t.报工次数 > 1;

scripts.name: 一道工序多次报工的工票
scripts.content:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT 
    crop_order_ticket_id as 工票id,
    process_serial_no as 工序号,
    produce_process_name as 工序名称,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY crop_order_ticket_id, process_serial_no 
      ORDER BY id ASC
    ) AS  报工次数
  FROM jack_mes.produce_produce_reporting_work
  WHERE 
    is_deleted = 0 
) t
WHERE t.报工次数 > 1;

scripts.name: 同工序版本工序号重复
scripts.content:
select 
    h_id 工序版本id,
    craft_seq 工序号,
    count(*) as 数量
from 
    jack_mes.product_product_process_info 
where
    is_deleted = 0
group by 
    h_id,craft_seq
having 
    count(*) > 1
